item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Your day's got structure around it—meals fit between the walk, the check-ins, the wind-down. Don't let it become another box to tick without noticing what's actually going into it. Eat like you're paying attention, not like you're just clearing the calendar. One action: before dinner tonight, actually decide what you're eating instead of defaulting to whatever's easiest.
